text:
infra-bot: [ALERT] reserved_pool_utilization eu-west-1 > 95% (reserved:dedi-eu-west). Soft-throttles observed. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1764109876

eva_infra: seeing increased queue length on pool d-eu-1 — ~3k pending, p50 ok but tail latency spikes to ~2s on some shards.

sam_sre: checking admission logs; drop rate rising. sample log: "admission_drop=0.12 reason=reserved_pool_saturated pool=d-eu-1"

maria_prod: any customer-visible errors yet or just internal retries?

jonah_eng: a handful of tenants hit 429/503. Canaries show long sequences + KV-cache misses amplifying token compute.

eva_infra: also seeing inter-zone packet loss in eu-west; tcp retransmit bursts correlate with GPU throughput drops.

sam_sre: propose mitigations: 1) enable cross-region burst to global-burst pool for non-gold tenants, 2) reduce per-tenant concurrency 8->4, 3) shorten admission queue TTL.

ops_lead: need quick cost call on cross-region burst — approximate delta?

jonah_eng: rough back-of-envelope: cross-region burst adds ~0.6 USD per 1k tokens for those routed; but prevents SLA breaches for many tenants.

maria_prod: can we route only silver/bronze to burst and keep gold on local reserved?

eva_infra: yes, routing policy supports tiered burst: set priority field sla_tier; gold disallowed.

oncall-bot: /run adm-control adjust --pool d-eu-1 --concurrency 4
oncall-bot: action accepted, concurrency cap updated for pool d-eu-1 (8 -> 4).

sam_sre: /run adm-control set-queue-ttl d-eu-1 30s
oncall-bot: queue TTL updated to 30s for d-eu-1.

jonah_eng: triggering autoscaler short-term bump: reserved_shards +1 in eu-west-zone-c.
eva_infra: autoscaler event started, provisioning reserved shard (eta ~3m).

infra-bot: metric snapshot: reserved_pool_drop_rate(d-eu-1) fell 12% -> 3% after TTL/concurrency changes and burst routing.

maria_prod: please prepare a short status page note: "Customers in EU may see degraded throughput; mitigation in progress."

ops_lead: approved cross-region burst for silver/bronze for 2 hours. track cost delta and rollback after stable.
sam_sre: filing ENGOPS-4728 and attaching admission logs + flame graphs.

jonah_eng: follow-up action: add regression test for long-sequence KV-cache miss pattern in CI to catch this class of saturation earlier.
eva_infra: post-mitigation: queue stable ~200 pending, tail latency back to expected range. Will monitor for 10m before clear.

infra-bot: [RESOLVE] reserved_pool_utilization alert resolved at 1764111420. Closing thread.
